provider.description: NatureServe is a biodiversity science organization and network that maintains standardized information on species and ecosystems, conservation status ranks, element occurrences, distributions, legal status, ecological systems, vegetation classification, habitat models, climate vulnerability, biodiversity importance, and conservation planning. Its principal platforms include NatureServe Explorer and Biotics, supported by a network of natural heritage programmes and conservation data centres.
institutional_context: NatureServe Network of natural heritage programmes and conservation data centres
Government, academic, nonprofit, museum, land-management, and biodiversity-informatics partners

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting NatureServe documentation, Explorer, Biotics, species, ecosystems, conservation ranks, element occurrences, distributions, legal statuses, geospatial data, methods, standards, APIs, downloads, schemas, licenses, citations, network information, institutions, related laws, and biodiversity authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: NatureServe, its network programmes, official standards and methods, Explorer, Biotics, official releases, official API documentation, responsible agencies, and cited sources remain authoritative for ranks, taxonomy, occurrences, ecosystems, legal status, versions, access restrictions, licenses, and contacts.
